column2: 1. **Direct match** — the word or phrase is searched case-insensitively in the dictionary index. Leading and trailing punctuation and whitespace are stripped automatically. Hebrew niqqud and cantillation marks are removed from the search term so pointed text can match unpointed headwords. Basic Arabic vowel marks (U+064B–U+0650, U+0652) and superscript alef (U+0670) are also removed; shaddah, hamza, and maddah remain significant. Multi-word phrases match dictionary entries containing spaces (such as idioms, phrasal verbs, or compound terms). An index may list the same headword more than once (one entry per part of speech, for example); every entry it lists is shown, each labelled with its headword.
